description: This file defines the CalculatedFieldFormService class, which provides methods for building and managing forms related to calculated fields, including alarm rules, and testing scripts within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldFormService
classes.description: Service class for creating and managing forms related to calculated fields and alarm rules, including script testing.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Creates a form group for a calculated field with fields: name, entityId, type, debugSettings, configuration.

methods.name: buildAlarmRuleForm
methods.description: Creates a form group for an alarm rule with specific configuration fields.

methods.name: setupTypeChange
methods.description: Sets up a subscription to handle changes in the 'type' field of the form, resetting configuration when type changes.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Prepares and defaults the calculated field configuration, setting output strategy if undefined.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Tests a calculated field script by fetching debug events and invoking a dialog function, returning an observable string.
